title: Deebo Samuel's contract voids, he'll count $12M against Commanders' cap and hit free agency

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Deebo Samuel's contract voids, he'll count $12M against Commanders' cap and hit free agency
sources.description: When the Commanders traded for wide receiver Deebo Samuel last year, it was understood at the time that he was headed for free agency in March of 2026.
